 Easterlies, 'amihan' to bring rains to parts of PH Tuesday
 by 
 Cristina Arayata
 Nov 10, 2026
 7:09 AM GMT+8
 WET TUESDAY. The easterlies and the northeast monsoon (amihan) will continue to bring rains to parts of the country on Tuesday (Nov. 10, 2026), the weather bureau said. Amihan will bring light rains over Cagayan Valley and the Cordillera Administrative Region, as well as isolated light rains over Metro Manila and the rest of Luzon. (PNA file photo) 
 MANILA – The easterlies and the northeast monsoon (amihan) will continue to bring rains to parts of the country on Tuesday, the weather bureau said.
 The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) said Caraga, Davao Region, Eastern Samar, Southern Leyte, Bohol, Misamis Oriental and Camiguin will experience scattered rain showers and thunderstorms due to the easterlies.
 Meanwhile, amihan will bring rains over Aurora, Quezon and Camarines Norte.
 PAGASA warned that moderate to heavy rains in these areas could trigger flash floods or landslides.
 Amihan will bring light rains over Cagayan Valley and the Cordillera Administrative Region, as well as isolated light rains over Metro Manila and the rest of Luzon.
 The rest of the country will experience isolated rain showers or thunderstorms due to the easterlies.
 PAGASA also forecast moderate to strong winds and moderate to rough seas over northern Luzon and the eastern sections of central and southern Luzon.
 Elsewhere, winds will be light to moderate, with slight to moderate seas. (PNA)
